messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-25]
    earlier: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-01-14 to 2025-08-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-14]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- As of 2026-03-03, the auth gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-03]
- The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- On 2026-04-14, team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, covering the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-21]
- Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-29]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-18 to 2025-12-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-18]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- The reporting service is owned by team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team flagged the reports pipeline as not their service. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2026-05-22, team Dune reported that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]

Question: What is the deploy window of the service that reporting depends on?

message.reasoning:
The reporting service depends on... Let's trace:

- "Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service." (valid 2025-09-23 to now)
- "As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs." (valid 2025-09-23 to now)

So now, reporting depends on the bus. The bus deploy window: "Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time." (valid 2025-04-18 to now)

But wait — there's an ownership conflict: "The reporting service is owned by team Dune" (2025-01-20 to now) vs "As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service" (2026-04-13 to now). Later supersedes, so Ember owns it — but that doesn't matter for this question.

Answer: Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.
